- Telemetry indicates AZ3’s network egress queue is saturating for instances serving Lucent’s model variant (longer context, larger batch sizes).
- us-east2 has ~30% free GPU headroom on the general pool; spinning reserved instances will take ~18–25 minutes.
- Immediate mitigation: we can do a soft drain of AZ3 and shift 60% of Lucent traffic to us-east2 within 3–4 minutes via routing policy change; remaining 40% can be bumped to us-west2 as a second-tier fallback.

Questions for leadership:
1) Approve emergency reserved capacity in us-east2 (1-week commit) to avoid repeated oscillation? This will incur a one-off cost; Lucent is asking for credit in their exec call.
2) Approve priority routing override for Lucent’s critical endpoints for the duration of the incident.

I’ll start the soft drain once I get the OK.
